conclusion: The framed route is compatible with the familiar S3 bridge in the smallest arity, but a separate framed-to-conjugation cover lemma is still needed for the finite-group detector route.
proof_summary: For B_2, a rack action is determined by the order of sigma_1. The framed C2 detector A_C2 has sigma_1 order 4.  S3^conj has sigma_1 order 12, so K_2(S3^conj) is contained in K_2(A_C2). This is only a two-strand compatibility check; it does not prove that framed detector racks are dominated by finite conjugation racks in all arities.
title: Framed-to-conjugation two-strand probe
